verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a code-driven automation SDK (TypeScript, Python, Go) with no interactive UI required. It can launch remote Browserbase browsers or local ones, or attach over CDP, so it naturally runs unattended. Cached deterministic replays and session recording support repeatable automated runs. missing for 10: an explicit headless-mode flag or setting in the docs, CI-specific setup guidance or examples (e.g. GitHub Actions), and independent hands-on reports of CI usage.
